freeze_rule: Before ANY result is read, fill every entry in fields_pending_at_freeze, then record the canonical sha256 of this file in the implementation card. Editing this file after results are read => STOP (administrative_abandoned_no_computed_evidence).
canonical_hash_scheme: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True) over the frozen subset (everything EXCEPT keys prefixed with '_').
_scope_and_claim: Candidate-free feasibility preflight. Uses the TLGP-R2 WORLD and rung0/rung1 DEFINITIONS as READ-ONLY inputs. Makes NO TLGP-R2 verdict (no H0/H1, no rung3). Only asks: is a rung0 (and then rung1) capability witness attainable. A positive merely unlocks drafting a candidate card; it is NOT transfer/mechanism evidence.

prereg_binding.world_source: read-only import of src.tlgp_001a.world via TLGP-R2 frozen world
prereg_binding.pass_function_source: read-only: rung0/rung1 pass_rule from prereg + src/tlgp_001b_r2/verdict.py + lower_reference.rung1_scanner

capacity_grid.status: FROZEN — imported from prereg; NEVER enlarged or shrunk in this preflight

phase0_zero_cost_readback.purpose: Decide, at ZERO new compute, whether the rung0 floor failure is plausibly budget-bound (warrants Phase 1) or already looks family/capacity-limited.
questions: Q0a: per primary family at rung0, was val_still_improving_at_stop true (budget-bound) or plateaued (family/capacity-limited)?
Q0b: ideal_R0 value — is the bar (ideal_R0 - DELTA) attainable in principle (ideal high)?
Q0c: fair-baseline (lookup/count_table) rung0 balacc — are they weak, i.e. is there real headroom a learner could occupy?
phase0_zero_cost_readback.decision_rule: If metas plateaued sub-bar AND fair baselines weak => lean family/capacity-limited; Phase 1 budget sweep is a long-shot, prefer cheap downgrade. If metas still-improving at stop => budget-bound hypothesis warrants Phase 1. If ideal_R0 < bar => route_needs_world_rung_redesign (report; do not retune).
phase0_zero_cost_readback.claim_ceiling: Phase 0 alone yields only a route LEAN, never a computed route_decision (no new trace).

phase1_budget_sweep.runs_only_if: Phase 0 indicates budget-bound, OR operator explicitly authorizes the full diagnostic despite a family-limited lean.
phase1_budget_sweep.permitted_relaxation_vs_tlgp_r2: TRAINING BUDGET ONLY (max_epochs / steps_max / lr_grid) at FROZEN capacity. This is explicitly NOT a TLGP-R2 run and asserts no H0/H1; it diagnoses budget-sensitivity of the rung0 floor.
rungs_tested: rung0_learnability_floor (checks 0a fit + 0b in-distribution heldout of the SAME 8 rules)
rungs_out_of_scope: rung3 REAL unseen-rule/unseen-value (the transfer experiment — this preflight NEVER touches it)
phase1_budget_sweep._swept_note: 200 epochs / 200000 steps / lr {0.001,0.0003} == the TLGP-R2 frozen budget (the baseline rung of the sweep); the larger values are the diagnostic extension. Final grid values are PENDING_AT_FREEZE pending Phase 0 (e.g. if still-improving, push higher; if plateaued, the sweep may be skipped).
phase1_budget_sweep.metric: balanced_accuracy on held-out queries (prereg primary metric key)

decision_function.name: route_decision.py
decision_function.must_call: the frozen prereg pass_function (no local recomputation of DELTA/close_fraction_min/seed-aggregation/metric/precedence)

outcomes.route_open_capability_witness_feasible: a fair learner PASSES the prereg bar with power-backed headroom over BOTH the fair baseline AND graph-cache, leakage-clean
outcomes.route_closed_identifiability_ceiling: ONLY if fair baseline/graph-cache saturates the attainable bar, OR an admissible upper-bound shows no learner advantage (NOT from a learner plateau alone)
outcomes.route_inconclusive_optimization_or_famil: ideal PASSES; fair baseline does NOT saturate; no learner passes under the declared budget; CI does not merely straddle
outcomes.inconclusive_underpowered: CI straddles the bar at N_SEEDS
outcomes.route_needs_world_rung_redesign: ideal fails the bar, or only forbidden capacity inflation would pass (requires a new card)

traps_wired_into_decision_function: equal_access_parity: any fair baseline matching the best learner at the witness rung => ceiling, not headroom
small_data_separation_evaporation: separation must rest on an asymptotic gap > eps; report MDE/power not a point gap
leakage: meta never receives rule_id or query_e; frozen 001A dual-target MI detector per channel per rung
capacity_inflation_guard: capacity grid frozen; only budget sweeps; any grid change => STOP
stop_conditions: bar/threshold tuned after seeing results => STOP
this plan not frozen (sha recorded) before results, or edited after => STOP
route verdict not derivable from route_decision.py => STOP
no sweep executed after two critique-only iterations => emit administrative_abandoned_no_computed_evidence (NOT route_closed, NOT banked as negative, NOT written to route_decision.json)
claim_ceiling: Bounded feasibility evidence only: whether a rung0/rung1 capability witness is attainable on this world under the frozen contract. Proves NOTHING about transfer (rung3/H1), mechanism, learning-as-mechanism, agency, self, subjectivity, AGI, or companion/EGO readiness. route_open authorizes ONLY drafting a later candidate card.

_phase0_readback_result_2026_06_29.cheapest_next_compute: Before any full sweep, run a MINIMAL Phase-1 probe: strongest single config (e.g. transformer d_model=256/layers=4) at rung0 ONLY, 2-3 seeds, extended budget (~600-800 epochs / higher steps_max), capacity FROZEN. If rung0 heldout climbs materially toward 0.9 => commit to full sweep (route_open trending). If flat => family-limited.
